name: Fashion Valley
description: Fashion Valley is San Diego's premier luxury shopping destination, featuring over 200 stores and restaurants including Neiman Marcus, Nordstrom, Bloomingdale's, and Macy's. This upscale enclosed regional mall showcases an impressive collection of high-end retailers like Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Tiffany & Co., and Apple, complemented by popular dining options and entertainment venues in the heart of Mission Valley.
demographics: Fashion Valley attracts affluent shoppers from San Diego's upscale neighborhoods including Mission Valley, La Jolla, and Del Mar. The trade area features high household incomes and strong fashion/luxury brand affinity.
summary: San Diego's premier luxury shopping destination featuring over 200 stores including Neiman Marcus, Nordstrom, Bloomingdale's, and the finest collection of luxury brands in the region.
